name: 施設名と評価の概要
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Create ONE Lighthouse component LH01-0026 施設名と評価の概要, a compact venue summary card.
Reference priority: input1 ORIGINAL Google Maps screenshot is authoritative for star geometry, actual fractional rating, wheelchair accessibility glyph, optical weight, alignment and fine details. Relevant original region x47 y347 width1081 height260. Input2 our rough native mock is SECONDARY for Japanese wording, example venue and compact hierarchy; its five fully green stars and missing wheelchair icon are inaccurate. Input3 approved bus component is STYLE ONLY, not content.
Exact Japanese content, left aligned in four compact rows: heading "代々木公園"; next row "4.7" followed by five small original-shaped stars with FOUR full stars and a fifth 70% amber with a light gray remainder, followed by "(14,868件)"; next row "公園 ·" then the original standard wheelchair-accessibility glyph and "車いす対応"; last row "営業中 · 22:00に終了". No other text or controls. Do not add photos, buttons, top navigation, maps, chips, ticket information, device chrome or logos.
Accent decision: preserve original warm amber/gold stars because they encode review rating, not brand selection. Preserve green only for the operational status word "営業中" (#1F6444). Closing time and separator remain secondary gray. Wheelchair glyph is a coherent slate supporting icon #526173, matching original anatomy rather than inventing a symbol; not a random colored icon. No green stars, no all-five-filled rating and no new selection.
Pure white #FFFFFF page and white rounded card, fine neutral border, restrained soft downward shadow. Compact readable composition with modest padding and four clear text lines. Meiryo heading Bold20/28, body Regular400 14/24, metadata Regular400 12/16, tracking0. Ink #1D1D1D and secondary #6E6E6E. Do not bold all labels. High-resolution flat frontal horizontal card around 3:1 within modest white margins, exact Japanese numerals and punctuation, no clipping. Keep original glyph proportions and fine details. This is a redesigned raster component, not a screen collage.
reviewNotes: All Japanese copy and values present, white card and operational green coherent. Source amber rating restored from wrong all-green mock. Residuals: fifth star looks half-filled despite requested 70%; wheelchair glyph substituted upright static symbol for original forward-leaning active geometry and remains blue instead of planned slate. Original controls details priority requires targeted correction. Candidate only, not owner approval or implementation.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
